resourceProfile.assessment: Canonical English, all effective Arabic runtime entries, the Arabic glossary, prior review metadata, and technical terminology searches were available.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review generation and TypeScript checking passed after all three iterations.

linguisticCritique.summary: Three further complete-scope passes resolved 75 calculator and shared-interface findings.

competentHumanReview.summary: The Arabic corrections were machine-reviewed and still require competent human review.

publicationAuthorization.summary: This cycle authorizes a locale-specific commit only, not publication or deployment.

findings.summary: Twenty-five converter, liquid-mixing, coil, and TCR entries used malformed plurals, literal action phrasing, or incorrect reference-resistance wording.
evidence: Converter units and gauge-system names had incorrect singular or gender forms.
Coil geometry used loop terminology where the interface describes an individual turn.
Base resistance was rendered as basic resistance rather than reference resistance.
findings.resolution: Rewrote calculator prompts, unit names, saved-state notices, coil geometry, and TCR reference labels in natural Arabic.

findings.summary: Twenty-five TCR and Wire Wizard entries inconsistently translated strands, heat flux, temperature notation, and construction labels.
evidence: Temperature labels expanded or altered protected °C and °F notation.
Heat flux disagreed with the established Arabic concept and calculator terminology.
Strands were called threads instead of wire strands.
findings.resolution: Standardized symbols and engineering vocabulary and replaced machine-literal action and explanation text.

findings.summary: Twenty-five shared UI and encyclopedia entries had unsafe placeholder agreement, missing sentence structure, and inconsistent catalog terminology.
evidence: Generic catalog item placeholders were embedded in gendered or ungrammatical phrases.
The home introduction omitted the Arabic copula needed for a complete sentence.
Control-board and source-backed-record labels varied across the same catalog view.
findings.resolution: Made placeholder sentences gender-neutral and corrected homepage, catalog, review-date, vaping, and control-board wording.
